label: Table
depicts: Square table grid with one middle divider and two horizontal dividers making six cells
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple six cell table split into two columns and three rows.
avoid_when: Do not use for the mixed panel table or the nine cell table when the grid should not add a third column.

label: Table
depicts: Square table grid with one narrow left column and one full width top row and one large lower right panel
use_when: Use when the interface wants the table to mix one left side column with one large block on the lower right.
avoid_when: Do not use for the even six cell table or the even nine cell table when the layout should not feature one oversized lower panel.

label: Table
depicts: Square table grid with two vertical dividers and two horizontal dividers making nine cells
use_when: Use when the interface wants the fullest even table grid with three columns and three rows.
avoid_when: Do not use for the six cell table or the uneven panel table when the layout should stay a uniform nine cell grid.

label: Tag
depicts: Price tag shape with one corner hole and one single outline around the body
use_when: Use when the interface wants the cleanest price tag silhouette with only one visible outline.
avoid_when: Do not use for the doubled tag when a second offset outline should appear behind the front tag body.

label: Tag
depicts: Price tag shape with one corner hole and one second offset tag outline behind it
use_when: Use when the interface wants the tag to read as stacked labels instead of a single front tag.
avoid_when: Do not use for the single tag when the mark should not show a second offset outline behind the front shape.
